content.value: Yield duplicates each affected original stack proportionally. The whole-number part grants guaranteed extra copies; the fractional part is the chance for one more copy. For example, 1.25 yield adds one guaranteed copy of the stack and has a 25% chance to add another. Final stack count is capped by that item's maximum stack size.

Log Yield affects logs. Sapling Yield affects saplings and apples from leaves.
Ore Yield affects standard ores and quartz; Overworld/Nether Ore Yield is added in its matching dimension. Gem Yield additionally affects diamond, emerald, and lapis ores. Flint Yield affects flint from gravel.
Crop Yield affects mature crop food; Seed Yield affects recognized seed drops.
Monster Drop Yield affects hostile-monster loot. Rare Mob Drop Chance is added as another monster-loot duplication value, with a Nether-specific addition.
Animal Drop Yield affects animal loot. Meat Yield adds again for beef, pork, chicken, mutton, and rabbit food drops.

Ore Fortune can duplicate normal ore drops when Silk Touch is not active.
Log Fortune has a chance to drop one extra natural log.
Crop Fortune, when harvesting a mature supported crop with a hoe, replaces the ordinary drop with twice the full original drop on success.
Dig Fortune can add flint from gravel, another full clay-ball drop from clay, or duplicate non-block drops from configured dig blocks.

Tool tooltip: the modded stat line shows Gathering Speed only, calculated from Mining Efficiency.
Precision Mining is a capped 0–100% chance for a gathering tool not to lose durability.
Repair Chance is a capped 0–100% chance for an applicable gear durability loss to be cancelled.
Breaking Range increases how far away you can interact with blocks.
Vein Mining searches connected blocks of the same ore type, breaks up to 31 additional blocks, consumes one durability per extra block, and stops before the tool breaks.
Several yield bonuses can add together on the same loot stack. Stack-size caps can waste part of a very large combined bonus.
